Dermal Fillers.heading: Compare exact filler presentations before requesting a quote
Dermal Fillers.copy: Start with the exact catalogue item rather than brand alone. Keep separate lines for different presentations and ask the supplier to define the quoted unit. A similar brand name does not establish equivalent formulation, intended use or suitability. Request the applicable manufacturer documents for the selected presentation.
checks: Record the exact item and pack presentation
Separate box quantity from individual units
Approve any proposed substitution in writing

Skin Boosters / PN.heading: Keep skin booster variants distinct in a mixed order
Skin Boosters / PN.copy: For requests involving Rejuran Healer, S, I or HB, identify each named presentation separately. The category is a catalogue grouping, not evidence that products share composition or can replace one another. Confirm manufacturer documentation, the number of units quoted and destination-specific requirements before comparing offers.
checks: List each Rejuran variant on its own order line
Ask for presentation and manufacturer documentation
Reconcile batch and expiry records on receipt

Toxin.heading: Review toxin quotations without assuming unit equivalence
Toxin.copy: Keep Botulax, Nabota, Rentox, Xeomin and Dysport requests separate by product and presentation. Do not use a price per labelled unit to infer equivalent clinical potency or dosing across brands. Purchasing teams should confirm exact product identity, applicable handling instructions and documentation for the intended destination.
checks: Keep brand and labelled presentation together
Do not infer cross-brand potency equivalence
Confirm handling requirements from applicable product documents

Body & Weight Care.heading: Separate body-care enquiries from prescription-product procurement
Body & Weight Care.copy: This catalogue group includes different types of requests. Lemon Bottle, Aqualyx, Lipo Vela and Mounjaro should not be compared as interchangeable items or treated as having the same status. Begin with exact identity and intended-use documentation, then verify the requirements applicable to the product and destination. A catalogue listing is not a claim of effectiveness or authorisation.
checks: Distinguish Lipo Vela from Lipo Vela V
Verify intended use and product status before purchase
Keep Mounjaro professional supply review separate from other body-care enquiries

Exosome / Meso.heading: Prepare a document-led ASCE Plus and meso enquiry
Exosome / Meso.copy: For ASCE Plus and other items in this group, specify the exact catalogue name, presentation and intended purchasing entity. Ask for applicable manufacturer information rather than assuming that a broad exosome or meso label establishes composition, permitted use or evidence of outcomes. Keep unresolved questions visible in the quotation record.
checks: Request manufacturer information for that item
Record unresolved product and destination questions

Biostimulator.heading: Confirm product identity before comparing biostimulator offers
Biostimulator.copy: Sculptra and Radiesse enquiries should retain the exact product name and presentation throughout the request, quotation and receiving records. Avoid treating a category label as proof of equivalent composition or clinical performance. Ask the supplier to clarify pack contents and supporting documents rather than inferring them from a previous order or article.
checks: Compare the complete commercial offer, not unit price alone
